title: Stale holder
summary: Migration territory owned by a terminal item is released when another rehearsal enters, then acquired for the new item; an old heartbeat alone never releases an active owner. Ending a session never releases its claims, and the stale-session sweep skips a session that still holds one, so a claim from an ended session stays until it is freed. A release by any other session refuses with claim_required, naming the holder session and the recovery: the holder releases it, or a steering-seat holder runs yoke sessions terminate HOLDER --reason TEXT, which ends the holder and releases every claim it keeps.
